description: Precomputed 40 ns MARTINI 3 run of the default notebook sample (CHEM 73000, Lecture 5 hands-on)
model: MARTINI 3 C1 beads, 4 CH2 groups per bead; bonds 0.47 nm (0.475 nm at chain ends), kb 3800; angles 180 deg, k 35 (G96)
protocol: pe_tools.build_melt (ideal chains at melt density) -> em.mdp -> npt_relax.mdp (0.5 ns, 10 fs) -> npt_equil.mdp (2 ns) -> md_precomputed.mdp (40 ns); before each grompp the structure is wrapped into the box (pe_tools.wrap_gro) and the run input is checked (pe_tools.check_tpr); trajectory unwrapped with: echo 0 | gmx trjconv -s equil.gro -f prod.xtc -o md_nojump.xtc -pbc nojump

files.start.gro: starting coordinates (whole chains); also numbers the chains for MDAnalysis
files.PE_chains.itp: one molecule type per chain length
files.chain_lengths.txt: beads per chain in start.gro order
